Divakar Saragadam 9381255380 | sdivakar342@gmail.com | https://github.com/Divakar205101 | www.linkedin.com/in/s-divakar

Professional Summary Java Full Stack Developer with 2.5 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise- level web applications in the insurance domain. Skilled in building scalable Spring Boot microservices and dynamic Angular frontends, with hands-on expertise in REST APIs, JWT authentication and CI/CD. Adept at solving complex problems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering business-focused solutions.

Skills Back-End: Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring JPA, Hibernate, Microservices, JWT Front-End: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, JSP, Ajax Tools & DevOps: Git, Postman, Swagger, Maven, Docker, AWS, Jenkins Database: MS SQL Other: Data Structures & Algorithms, Design Patterns

Professional Experience Software Engineer Chegus Infotech

April 2023 – Present

Collaborated with business teams to understand requirements and develop products aligned with

business needs.

Designing and developing both front-end and back-end systems tailored to meet client specifications

with in the insurance domain.

Adapting existing implementations to accommodate new requirements or improvements.  Conducting impact assessments on individual changes, ensuring the composition of modular and optimized code without interrupting current functionalities.

Engaging in bug resolution and system debugging to maintain optimal performance.  Identifying the root cause of issues and executing timely resolutions within defined timelines  Developing comprehensive unit tests and overseeing database operations to ensure accurate data insertion or modification during the initial development phases.

Having Good Exposure on implementing OOPs Principles.  Hands on Experience working with ORM Technology Hibernate. 

Implemented inter-service communication using Feign Client, ensuring seamless API integration between services.

Optimized application performance by replacing CDN-based libraries with locally stored files, ensuring seamless functionality even in low or no internet conditions.

Designed and implemented multi-module applications in Spring Boot, improving code modularity, maintainability, and scalability.

Built and deployed a full-stack application by generating an executable JAR for Spring Boot backend and building the Angular frontend.

Used Maven to build and generate executable JAR files for Spring Boot backend services.  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins/Git CI to automate build and deployment processes for Spring Boot and Angular applications.

Developed and maintained Spring Boot microservices in a distributed architecture to handle insurance domain workflows.

Projects AFRI - Life Insurance Software Management Application Responsibilities:



Involved in the discussion, estimation, analysis, design and implementation of Business requirements.

Fixing the defects raised during testing.  Used best coding practices and naming conventions while writing code in Java and spring.  Created and modified new and existing pages, applied new styles on the pages with the help of JavaScript and Angular.

Resolved production issues and implemented requirement changes to improve system performance and usability.

Technologies Used:

Frontend: Angular, HTML, CSS  Backend: Spring Boot, Hibernate  Database: MS SQL  Version Control: Git

Acacia - Health Insurance Portal Responsibilities:

Developed and enhanced microservices architecture using Spring Boot.   Designed and developed dynamic Angular forms to collect and validate user data efficiently.  Designed and implemented DTO (Data Transfer Object) classes for structuring API request bodies.  Utilized Object Mapper to efficiently map DTO classes to DO classes for seamless data processing and database operations.

Integrated Feign Client to facilitate efficient inter-service communication between microservices.

Designed and developed a Global Exception Handler in Spring Boot, ensuring centralized error handling across the application.

Logged and tracked exceptions efficiently using SLF4J aiding in faster debugging and issue resolution

Technologies:

Frontend: Angular, HTML, CSS,  Backend: Spring Boot  Database: MS SQL

Education BSC - VDA Degree College

Certifications • JavaFullStack Developer – Jspiders • REST API – Hacker Rank

sections.text:
Projects AFRI - Life Insurance Software Management Application Responsibilities:

Involved in the discussion, estimation, analysis, design and implementation of Business requirements.
Fixing the defects raised during testing.  Used best coding practices and naming conventions while writing code in Java and spring.  Created and modified new and existing pages, applied new styles on the pages with the help of JavaScript and Angular.
Resolved production issues and implemented requirement changes to improve system performance and usability.
Technologies Used:
Frontend: Angular, HTML, CSS  Backend: Spring Boot, Hibernate  Database: MS SQL  Version Control: Git
Acacia - Health Insurance Portal Responsibilities:
Developed and enhanced microservices architecture using Spring Boot.   Designed and developed dynamic Angular forms to collect and validate user data efficiently.  Designed and implemented DTO (Data Transfer Object) classes for structuring API request bodies.  Utilized Object Mapper to efficiently map DTO classes to DO classes for seamless data processing and database operations.
Integrated Feign Client to facilitate efficient inter-service communication between microservices.
Designed and developed a Global Exception Handler in Spring Boot, ensuring centralized error handling across the application.
Logged and tracked exceptions efficiently using SLF4J aiding in faster debugging and issue resolution
Technologies:
Frontend: Angular, HTML, CSS,  Backend: Spring Boot  Database: MS SQL
